name: GridFilterModel
description: Model describing the filters to apply to the grid.

entries.name: logicOperator
entries.description:
- `GridLogicOperator.And`: the row must pass all the filter items.
- `GridLogicOperator.Or`: the row must pass at least on filter item.

entries.name: quickFilterExcludeHiddenColumns
entries.description: If `false`, the quick filter will also consider cell values from hidden columns.

entries.name: quickFilterLogicOperator
entries.description:
- `GridLogicOperator.And`: the row must pass all the values.
- `GridLogicOperator.Or`: the row must pass at least one value.

entries.name: quickFilterValues
entries.description: values used to quick filter rows
